context: Reference focused cleanup: Java 25 line-to-zero-or-one stream transformations should prefer mapMulti over side-effecting forEach or line-level flatMap when appropriate.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 25 artifact
checklist.description: Returns complete Java 25-compatible DeclarationExtractor code with necessary imports, records, methods, and Pattern usage intact.

checklist.name: Produces the result through the pipeline
checklist.description: Refactors declarations(Card) so the stream pipeline returns the final declarations via toList rather than mutating an external List from forEach.

checklist.name: Uses mapMulti for zero-or-one emission
checklist.description: Uses mapMulti or an equivalent Consumer-based emitter for the line-to-zero-or-one Declaration transformation, avoiding tiny Stream.of/Stream.empty allocations as the preferred final shape.

checklist.name: Keeps text-block flatMap acceptable
checklist.description: Uses flatMap only where each text block naturally expands to a stream of declarations, and does not confuse that with the line-level zero-or-one transformation.

checklist.name: Preserves filters and matching
checklist.description: Filters null and blank text blocks, keeps LABELED_SOURCE.matcher(line).matches(), preserves the captured value, and searches title, description, and comments.

checklist.name: Avoids side-effecting stream terminals
checklist.description: Does not keep text.lines().forEach(...) or helper methods whose purpose is mutating a caller-owned declarations list.

checklist.name: Keeps implementation readable
checklist.description: Extracts a small emitter helper when useful and avoids custom collectors, large abstractions, or unrelated parser changes.

metadata.reference_selection: Focused issue #40 coverage for mapMulti declaration extraction instead of side-effecting forEach.
metadata.runtime_reference_overlap_rationale: Allowed only as reference-suite focused coverage; do not report as ordinary broad lift if runtime references later teach this same mapMulti shape.
